detail.goal: Sign on as operator "super1" with [REDACTED] "[REDACTED]" at branch "MAIN-001", then from the Main Menu choose "Place Account Hold". Search for member number "103001" (leave "Search by" set to Member Number) and select that member from the results. On the Place Account Hold form, select the option whose value is exactly "103001-S0001" in the "Share:" dropdown, select the option whose value is exactly "FRAUD" in the "Reason Code:" dropdown, leave "Notes:" blank, and click Continue. On the review page, confirm the details shown match (member, share, reason) and click "Apply Hold" to post it. Once you reach the confirmation page, extract the Confirmation number (store as "confirmationNumber").
